notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
[p]I’ve opened a spot in [b]Discussions → Bugs[/b] for issues and feedback—feel free to drop notes there or reply here.
[/p][p][b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]

- [b][i]Crashes:[/i][/b][i] If it goes plop and vanishes, please share what you were doing, your settings, and your specs—I’ll dive for it.[/i][/p][p][i]
- [/i][b]FPS dip on big deletions[/b]: When you scoop out a large patch of detail, FPS may sink like a stone into pond mud. I’m on it and aiming to patch this soon.[/p][p]
[b]Thanks for testing and helping the pond get clearer![/b] 🌿🐟[/p]

notes.title: 🌿 Pond – Dev Update
